# Scope Processes

**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Use this file for PM-10 through PM-15. Scope includes requirements, quality, decomposition, control, and acceptance.

| ID | Process | Purpose | Inputs | Outputs | Tailoring | Check | Authority | PMI source |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PM-10 | Plan Scope Management | Define how scope will be developed, accepted, and controlled. | Charter, requirements approach, lifecycle, governance rules | Scope approach, acceptance approach, change route | Use a short scope note for stable small work; formal scope and acceptance rules for complex work. | Scope ownership, change route, acceptance authority, and traceability are clear. | Drafts approach; PM approves material scope controls. | 2.2.2.1 |
| PM-11 | Elicit and Analyze Requirements | Discover, analyze, document, and prioritize needs. | Stakeholders, business need, current state, constraints, research | Requirements, priorities, traceability, acceptance criteria, open questions | Match elicitation methods and detail to uncertainty, stakeholder complexity, and risk. | Each requirement has source, rationale, priority, owner or approver, and testable outcome. | Facilitates and records; stakeholders approve their requirements. | 2.2.2.2 |
| PM-12 | Define Scope | Establish the boundaries and intended deliverables of the work. | Requirements, business case, constraints, assumptions, options | Scope statement, inclusions, exclusions, deliverable definitions | Use high-level boundaries for adaptive discovery; detailed scope for committed delivery. | Inclusions, exclusions, assumptions, constraints, and success measures are explicit. | Drafts scope; PM or authorized sponsor approves commitment. | 2.2.2.3 |
| PM-13 | Develop Scope Structure | Break deliverables and work into manageable components. | Scope statement, requirements, product structure, delivery approach | WBS, backlog structure, work packages, traceability links | Use WBS, product backlog, or a hybrid based on delivery approach. | Decomposition supports estimating, ownership, sequencing, and acceptance without hidden work. | Prepares structure; PM approves baselined scope structure. | 2.2.2.4 |
| PM-14 | Monitor and Control Scope | Detect scope variance and manage boundary changes. | Scope baseline, backlog, requirements, change requests, progress evidence | Scope variance, proposed changes, updated traceability, decisions | Increase review frequency when requirements or stakeholders change rapidly. | Work delivered is traceable and unapproved scope change is visible. | May flag and draft; PM directs change or rejects it. | 2.2.2.5 |
| PM-15 | Validate Scope | Obtain evidence that completed work meets agreed acceptance conditions. | Deliverables, acceptance criteria, test results, stakeholder review | Acceptance record, rejected items, defects or change proposals | Use lightweight review for low-risk work; formal acceptance evidence for commitments. | Acceptance authority, criteria, evidence, and unresolved exceptions are recorded. | Prepares evidence; customer, sponsor, or delegated approver accepts. | 2.2.2.6 |
